svg.aria-label: Tekton system map. COMPAS Timber authors the TimberModel and builds the StructuralGraph that idealises the geometry; neither is part of Tekton. Tekton reads that graph and translates it into the neutral StructuralModel, driven identically from Grasshopper, the desktop application or a plain script. From there the model object reaches the Dlubal and SAF adapters directly; only Grasshopper serializes it to JSON so a worker subprocess can call the same adapters. Results return to the neutral model and are attached onto the beams.
svg.text: COMPAS TIMBER · AUTHORS AND IDEALISES THE GEOMETRY
TEKTON · GRASSHOPPER, DESKTOP OR SCRIPT — ALL USE compas_timber_fea
